answer: Dynamic Workload Routing Tax. The network assigns verification tasks by channeling requests through a cryptographic bridge that measures real-time cryptographic puzzle solution latency. When an agent requests a workload spike, a low-entropy zephyr puzzle is injected into its request pipeline to measure physical execution delay. An attacker cloning an agent to bypass local capacity limits triggers a processing gale, because duplicate nodes share the same underlying hardware threads, causing severe CPU contention and exponentially higher computational latency.
